qualification: One seed and development subsets only; reserved tests are untouched. The ordinary and fusion-only runs start from the same O5b native backbone and consume the exact same mixed-data targets, order, reset contexts and update budget. Ordinary trains all native parameters with LR 1e-5; O5c trains only 8,388,608 fusion parameters with LR 1e-4 over a frozen backbone. This is an equal-data practical continuation control, not a pure FBT ablation or a match of trainable capacity, FLOPs, memory or wall time. Ordinary uses one CE term; O5c's ordinary CE term was constant with respect to its trainable fusion. Curves use 128 windows; endpoint comparisons use 512. Online FBT is teacher-forced sequential feedback, not free-running generation. Bootstrap intervals cover evaluation-document variability only, excluding training-seed variance and unknown pretraining overlap. WikiText is a narrow general-text proxy.
